item.tib: bcud 'dus nor bu phreng ba'i sbyin sreg dus nye mkho dran pa tshe dbang sku bstod nyung du bris pa
item.coloph: ces pas rig 'dzin dran pa tshe dbang sku bstod 'di/ bcud 'dus nor bu 'phreng ba'i sbyin sreg skabs su sku bstod mchod grangs snying po rnams bgrags (sbrag)dgos bzhin/ de lugs khyer bde yig gsal nang nas zur du bkod pas/ nyer mkho ltar la dbyil bla ming tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bdag gis bkod pas/ nyes 'gal mchis na rig 'dzin tshogs la bshags//
